pages.markdown:
In 2024, the consultancy industry continued its rise, drivenby the growingdemand for technological strategic and operational solutions helping organizations in all sectors face the challenges of an ever more complex and changing environment, subject tofast-paced technological development.

Sector firms have proven their capacity to adapt, responding with agility to the new challenges and needs facing companies and government agencies. The increase in revenue recorded in 2024 strengthens the position of consultancy as a key industry in thetransformationoftheproductionmodel and the evolutiontowards a moreresilienteconomy.

Once again, the industry dynamics can be seen uponcomparing itsevolutiontothatof theentire economy. In 2024, revenue generated by consulting firms grew 8.8%, in comparison to the 6.3% increase in nominal GDP. This difference — 2.5 percentage points — confirms a structural trend that has been repeating itself for more than a decade: consultancy has consistently grown above the GDP, positioning itself asoneof themaindriversofgrowthinthe Spanish economy.

The increase in consultancy revenue

in 2024 remained above the growth in nominal GDP in Spain
